citation.title: ABO analysis norms

curation.notes: accessed 2026-10-07 (both extractors read the live page that day). Page dated June 12, 2026. The page names no source paper for the norms and describes no sample. Merge 2026-10-08: a and b agree on every value, unit and definitionMatch; only the source wording differed (b's row-specific wording kept). Re-read with WebFetch on 2026-10-08 (15:20): every value matched; the page says nothing on whether ± is an SD; the mandibular plane is written 'Go–Me' without saying which gonion, so #90–#92 stay 'close' (owner 8 Oct: ABO stays on the website values).

caveats: Website values, not from a paper (status website; never coloured).
No source paper, sample, population, sex or age stated on the page.
The page prints every norm as 'x ± y' without saying whether y is an SD or a range; stored as sd with a note.
The page gives no norm for U1–NA (°) (#47) or L1–NB (°) (#50), which the catalogue's ABO list (ABO 2025 slides) includes — only the mm versions; those two have no norm. No interincisal angle (C6).

The page's SN-MP, FMA and IMPA use 'Go–Me' without saying which gonion; they are entered against the catalogue's ABO measurements #90, #91, #92 (constructed gonion, the ABO's own definition) as 'close'.
The owner's ABO tracing PDF is an example patient, not norms (owner 8 Oct); it was not used.
